correctness.rationale: A direct affine orbit-barycenter model identifies geometric fixed points exactly. The independence triple cutoff limits original face sizes to four. A separate exhaustive verifier reconstructed 1,221 cases, used only as corroboration.

value.rationale: A complete infinite-family PL fixed-locus classification supplies integral homotopy types, fundamental groups, and canonical polygon subdivisions for every nonidentity dihedral symmetry. It distinguishes half-turns, higher rotations, and two reflection-axis types, upgrading previously known ambient S3 and homological characters to geometric fixed-space structure.
